title: Scripted runner errors
description: The scripted runner's own error codes, beyond the runner contract's. They fill the contract's runnerErrors extension point.

oneOf.description: The script or recording is malformed, names an unknown step, or a step has a field the step doesn't define.
The run/start options hold a key other than script, scriptPath and replayDelays.

where.description: Where in the options or script the problem is, such as options.script.steps[2].
